description: Defines the AOS_Products_Quotes class extending AOS_Products_Quotes_sugar, with methods for saving quote lines, marking lines as deleted, and saving the object, within the SuiteCRM/AOS_Products_Quotes module.

classes.name: AOS_Products_Quotes
classes.description: Represents quote line items in SuiteCRM, with methods to save lines, mark lines as deleted, and save the quote object.

methods.name: save_lines
methods.description: Processes and saves quote line items from posted data, handling deletions, group associations, and setting properties before saving each line.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Performs additional save operations via AOS_Utils and then calls parent save method.

methods.name: mark_lines_deleted
methods.description: Marks all linked quote lines as deleted for a given parent quote object.
